data.gender_notes: Golala is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'gul' meaning flower. This name is often given to girls born during the blooming season or to symbolize the beauty and delicacy of nature. The name Golala carries the meaning “Little flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Golala usually hope their child will grow to embody little flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Golala total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
